assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
to address the patient's history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
